title: Renderium Optimized [REBORN]
description: Engineered for the Ultimate Performance Boost!
body:
# **🚀 Renderium Reborn | Performance & QoL Modpack**

Renderium is a professional optimization modpack built from the ground up for Minecraft 26.2 Fabric. It aims to deliver maximum performance, buttery-smooth graphics, and enhanced quality of life (QoL) without compromising the classic vanilla feel of the game.

By utilizing your system's hardware resources efficiently, Renderium eliminates micro-stuttering, skyrockets your FPS, and stabilizes server connections.

## 🏎️ **_Raw Performance & Hardware Optimization_**

   **Graphical Revolution:** Powered by Sodium and ImmediatelyFast for a flawless rendering experience.

 -  **Smart Memory & CPU Management:** Integrated with Lithium, ModernFix, and FerriteCore to ensure minimal RAM consumption and maximum CPU efficiency.

 -  **Advanced Culling Technology:** With EntityCulling and More Culling, hidden objects outside your field of view will no longer drain your hardware performance.

 -  **Background Friendly:** Dynamic FPS automatically reduces resource usage when you Alt-Tab out of the game, letting your PC rest.

## 🌐 **_Seamless Connectivity & Server Tweak_**

 -  Optimized data traffic via Krypton and Very Many Players (VMP) reduces ping and eliminates packet loss on servers.
  
 -  ServerCore minimizes tick spikes and stabilizes MSPT (Milliseconds Per Tick) in your singleplayer worlds.

## 🎨 **_Visual Enhancements & Clean UI_**

  - **Shader Support:** Built-in high-performance shader support courtesy of Iris.

  -  **Dynamic Animations:** Full compatibility with advanced custom models thanks to the Entity Model Features (EMF) and ETF framework.

  -  **Quality of Life:** AppleSkin, Shulker Box Tooltip, and EnhancedTooltips keep you well-informed with clean, non-intrusive UI overlays.
 
## 🛡️ **_Stability & Security_**

   - Featuring Not Enough Crashes and CrashExploitFixer—if something goes wrong, your game won't just shut down; it will prevent the crash and pinpoint the problematic mod for you.

## 📦 **_Installation & Important Notes_**

  -  Install the modpack with a single click using your preferred launcher (Prism Launcher, CurseForge, etc.).

  -  To ensure all pre-configured optimization settings are active, make sure the default resource packs are enabled upon your first launch.

### 💡 Note: This pack is fully stripped of unnecessary library bloat to provide the cleanest and most responsive Minecraft experience possible. It is ideal for low-end systems looking for playable frame rates, as well as high-refresh-rate (Hz) monitor owners aiming for maximum smoothness.
